column1: # Real equity cross-index anchors: per-instrument depth-vs-volatility measurements. Since 0.21.0
# these are LIVE CALIBRATION INPUTS, not a pending fixture: the w2001w block is what
# EquityD5Corr/EquityD10Corr/EquityD20Corr, EquityVolSupport and the two gate bands are fitted
# from, and EquityAnchorSuite / equity_anchor_tests re-derive every one of them from this file.
# Editing a row moves the shipped model. Nothing is fitted from any other block.
# The relation those constants define is
# i.e. the random walk's own closed form for time under water, times a correction fitted linear in
# volatility. The correction reaches 1.00 at the top of the volatility range below, for all three
# rungs independently: the most volatile equity markets spend random-walk time under water, and a
# market at 14% volatility spends about half of it. Fitted by least squares on the LOG ratio --
# raw-ratio OLS leaves the 20% rung's median instrument at 0.91 of its own line.
# Measured 2026-08-26 from daily Yahoo total-return series (adj_close), data through 2026-08-24.
# Definitions are uni.apps.MarketSim's own, verified by reproduction: the w1993 row below is SPY
# over the committed anchor window and reads exactly the three depth fit targets (0.447 / 0.315 /
# 0.169) and the 18.6% volatility the docs quote.
#   annVol   sqrt(mean(logret^2) * 252) * 100 -- uncentered, like the model's `vol`
#   d5..d20  share of sessions strictly more than 5/10/20% below the running peak (depthShares)
#   w1993    1993-01-29..2026-08-20  SPY only -- the committed-anchor validation row
#   w1996    1996-03-18..2026-08-20  17 instruments, 30.4y; opens mid-bull, so its peak seed is
#            clean by construction (warm re-measurement changes no row)
#   w2001    2001-08-27..2026-08-20  35 instruments, 24.9y; peak seeded at the window's first
#            session, the depthShares convention -- which TRUNCATES drawdowns inherited from
#            before a window that opens mid-bear, and this one does
#   w2001w   the same window and instruments with the peak seeded from each instrument's FULL
#            prior history, so the inherited hole is measured rather than truncated
# The w2001/w2001w pair MEASURES that truncation: fitting on w2001 and predicting w1996 reads
# R2 0.47 with median ratio 1.08; fitting on w2001w reads R2 0.66, median 0.96. The two clean
# measurements agree, the truncated one does not -- fit bands from w2001w (widest support,
# n=35), use w1996 as the independent check, and never grade a model ensemble against the
# Depth is NOT a function of volatility alone: return-per-unit-volatility carries the rest, the
# same quantity that sets the model's own depth profile. On w2001w,
# Fit on ALL 35 rows: the internationals span the rv range that identifies the rv coefficient
# (a US-only refit flips its sign -- collinearity, not information). Residual ratios run
# 0.69-1.48; the deep tail is QQQ (1.37) and XLK (1.48), whose restored dot-com hole is a
# regime the sample holds exactly once, with Japan (EWJ 1.29) the same story older. That scatter

# Scope: broad, sector and country equity funds only. Leveraged funds and single stocks are
